name: hive-agent-skills
description: Hive Intelligence skills for Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, and other agents. Covers Hive MCP setup, tool discovery, crypto workflows, CLI flows, and browser-based sign-in. Install via `npx -y -p hive-intelligence@latest hive init --all --browser` or copy the packs into the target agent skills directory.

skills.name: hive-cli
skills.description: Use the `hive` CLI inline from a chat — query prices, scan wallets, check token security, automate briefings.

skills.name: hive-mcp
skills.description: Add Hive's MCP server to Claude Code, Cursor, VS Code, Windsurf, Claude Desktop, ChatGPT, or Gemini CLI. Per-client instructions.

skills.name: hive-build-onboarding
skills.description: Walk the user through browser-based sign-in. Use when the user has no API key or cannot find theirs.

skills.name: hive-build
skills.description: Integrate Hive into app code via REST or MCP SDK. Python, TypeScript, Go, Java, Rust patterns with retry / async / typed responses.

skills.name: hive-query
skills.description: Route crypto questions through canonical task toolsets, schema lookup, and exact tool invocation.

skills.name: hive-tool-discovery
skills.description: Find the right Hive tool, task toolset, schema, or endpoint before execution.

skills.name: hive-market-research
skills.description: Research live prices, liquidity, exchanges, OHLC, order books, funding rates, and derivatives.

skills.name: hive-token-diligence
skills.description: Investigate token metadata, market context, liquidity, holders, enrichment, and risk.

skills.name: hive-wallet-investigation
skills.description: Inspect wallet balances, transfers, NFTs, PnL, DeFi positions, and notable activity.

skills.name: hive-security-risk
skills.description: Check token, approval, address, dApp, phishing, contract, and simulation risk.

skills.name: hive-dex-pool-analysis
skills.description: Analyze pools, pairs, liquidity, trades, OHLCV, and DEX flow.

skills.name: hive-defi-research
skills.description: Analyze DeFi protocols, TVL, fees, revenue, stablecoins, bridges, and yields.

skills.name: hive-nft-research
skills.description: Research NFT collections, ownership, metadata, floors, sales, rarity, and spam checks.

skills.name: hive-solana-analysis
skills.description: Analyze Solana wallets, SPL accounts, DAS assets, parsed transactions, and priority fees.

skills.name: hive-network-infrastructure
skills.description: Read chain state, gas, blocks, receipts, logs, transaction status, and RPC diagnostics.

skills.name: hive-prediction-markets
skills.description: Research prediction markets, events, outcomes, market stats, traders, holders, and trades.

skills.name: hive-stateful-monitoring
skills.description: Create, list, update, and archive durable crypto monitors, alerts, scheduled reports, and agent memory.
